hypothesis: Broader kernels add receptor-frame spatial attraction at larger distances while the original scale retains local detail.
formula: Mean of MMD distances at sigma,2sigma,4sigma, then same mass-weighted soft mixture.
parameter_origin: Integer scale multiples are an engineering hypothesis; baseline sigma comes from discovery reference spacing. eta=.1 and T=.03 held fixed.
reason: Test representation scale independently before increasing external dose.
acceptance: Frozen criterion: >=2% primary improvement and both adaptation batches improve vs accepted incumbent (currently native). Round1 is an exploratory parent, not a promoted incumbent: batch 0 improved, batch 1 worsened.
limitations: Hard atom/bond mismatch is high in stochastic intermediate states; shape success is not complete molecular/chemical reproduction.
